roadmap.title: Early investigations and combat
roadmap.description: Play on any difficulty. Collect early items, accept side jobs before departure, and begin the barrel and crushing counters. Save 6,000 coins for shop-only cards and at least 1,500 for card matches.

roadmap.title: Cases, cards, and side jobs
roadmap.description: Check the hub after each case update. Complete all 14 side jobs, collect optional evidence, and win 30 card matches. Save during the hub visit when The Bookkeeper becomes available, before leaving the BMP Agitator encounter.

roadmap.title: Final missions and recovery
roadmap.description: Collect the Portable Freezer, finish the upgrades, and complete the final missions. After the ending, use Continue to return to the hub and Revisit completed missions for missing items or jobs.

achievements.description: Unlock every special ability.

steps.text: Speak to the Shrew Docker in @loc{Fair Enough} to learn the final climbing ability.

achievements.description: Collect all non-corporate-locked weapons
achievements.summary: Collect every weapon except the X1 D-Mousifier.

steps.text: Pick up each weapon along the story route. Collect the Portable Freezer in the basement of Bandel's Mansion to finish the set.

achievements.description: Win 30 Baseball Card matches. Home Run!

steps.text: Play Baseball Cards at the Little & Big or a Roadhouse. Each match costs 50 coins, so reserve at least 1,500 coins for 30 wins.
Ban weak cards when deck editing becomes available. Use your two redraws each turn to find stronger player cards, and pair them with tactic cards that raise their strength.
Win 30 matches. Use strong batters to score and strong pitchers to stop the opponent.

achievements.description: Pin every clue to your evidence board
achievements.summary: Pin every clue to the evidence board.

steps.text: After each mission and hub conversation, return to the P.I. Office and pin the new clues.
After defeating Ze Professor in Glugging from the Deep, collect his clue and pin it when you return.

guide.context: Collect the optional clues below as well as the main-objective evidence. Complete the side jobs as they open. Ze Orders in One Flew is the final key-clue checkpoint for Blue Betty. If you leave a collectible behind, drive to its completed mission on the overworld map and choose Revisit. After the ending, Continue returns you to the hub. Keep a separate manual save before the final case clue; case achievements can occasionally fail to unlock.

guide.context: Use the clue checklist under Burdens of Blue Betty to check earlier optional evidence. If a clue was left behind, revisit its mission and then return to the evidence board. Keep a separate manual save before the final case clue; case achievements can occasionally fail to unlock.

steps.text: Collect the optional clues from Bandel's Poster onward and finish the available side jobs.
In Saltwater Cambozo, collect Ze Crooked Collab. Follow up with Miles Curd at the Opera Ruins and finish the remaining case dialogue.

achievements.description: Complete every side job. Dot those i’s, detective

guide.context: Accept each hub job before its mission and report back to the client afterward. The two riverboat jobs begin and end aboard the boat. If you pass a job objective, use Revisit from the overworld map to return to its mission.

collectibles.name: Show Some Culture, Jack
collectibles.location: Tammy Tumbler; burning opera balcony.
collectibles.method: Accept the job from Tammy before the opera. After the boss fight, photograph the burning audience from the balcony. Report to Tammy.

collectibles.name: Blueprints, Please
collectibles.location: Tammy Tumbler; suspended train carriage.
collectibles.method: Accept the job before Cheeseball Sub. Near the late typewriter and ladder, tailpick the door and pull the lever. Ride the updraft to the suspended carriage and take the Interesting Blueprint. Return to Tammy.

collectibles.name: The Things We Keep
collectibles.location: Wanda Fuller; backstage movie set.
collectibles.method: Accept Wanda's job before departing. After the set shootout, search the bookcase, bar, and rope spool for Wanda's Letter; its position varies. Return the letter to Wanda.

collectibles.group: A Bit of Curd and Pepper
collectibles.name: They Call it "Azurro Burgerro"
collectibles.location: John Brown; fire beneath the upper room.
collectibles.method: Accept John's job before the Opera Ruins. Swing across the hooks beside the locked entrance door and enter the wall opening. Go downstairs and use the fire to cook the patty. Return to John.

collectibles.name: Fishy Business
collectibles.location: John Brown; damaged house in the back alleys.
collectibles.method: Accept John's job before Wallop Bay. When Jack notices the smell, grapple into the upper house and drop through the broken floor to collect Marina 8-ED Herring. Return to John.

collectibles.name: Imported Goods
collectibles.location: Cornelius Stilton; locked courtyard shop.
collectibles.method: Accept Stilton's job before Wallop Bay. After speaking to Bozo, break the courtyard boxes and tailpick the hidden door. Collect the Herbal Cheese Sticks from the back-room desk and return to Stilton.

collectibles.name: Perfect Bog Fondue
collectibles.location: John Brown; Old Cheeselegger and three packages.
collectibles.method: Accept John's job before Damp Evidence. Ask the Old Cheeselegger for the recipe. Collect the three thingies: below the mine elevator switch, in the mansion dining room with the cracked wall, and on the sunken boat beneath two pipes. Find the Old Cheeselegger behind the building near the final pier, then return the recipe to John.

collectibles.name: Oh Yes... They Float
collectibles.location: Millie Curd; balloon stall beyond the four-ticket gate.
collectibles.method: Accept Millie's job before the Secret Show. Buy Deflated Balloons for 25 coins after opening the four-ticket gate. Return to Millie.

collectibles.name: Poster Girl
collectibles.location: Tammy Tumbler; wall beside the Extra.
collectibles.method: Talk to Tammy before The Bookkeeper until she offers the job. After the bottomless-set parkour, ask the Extra where the Bookkeeper went. Take the poster from the nearby CHEESEPIERSER wall and return it to Tammy.

collectibles.name: Between Alpha and Omega
collectibles.location: BMP Yes-Man; Deck 1 window.
collectibles.method: Accept the job from the BMP Yes-Man in the cigar room reached after the vent. After getting the Membership Card, descend to Deck 1. Photograph the couple through the second window near the shortcut door. Return to the Yes-Man before leaving the boat.

collectibles.name: Mouseburg Confidential
collectibles.location: Undercover Agent on Deck 2; Deck 3 concert hall.
collectibles.method: Accept the agent's job on the outside deck. Go to the Deck 3 concert hall and photograph the three BMP members in the left corner. Return to the agent before leaving the boat.

collectibles.name: Behind the Nuts
collectibles.location: Tammy Tumbler; hidden asylum wing.
collectibles.method: Accept Tammy's job before One Flew. Play C-A-G-E on the piano on the central second-floor platform to lower the bridge. Cross into the new wing and photograph Gloria in her cell. Return to Tammy.

collectibles.name: Slugs in the Shell
collectibles.location: John Brown; container on the left of the port.
collectibles.method: Before Glugging from the Deep, ask John for this job. Search the port's left-hand container for the Can of Sea Slugs, then deliver the can to John.

collectibles.name: Friends in Deep Places
collectibles.location: Cameron Bozo; underwater side passage.
collectibles.method: Accept Cameron's job before Glugging from the Deep. In the large underwater cavern with the submarine, find the side opening behind seaweed. Climb the ladder and follow the path to his friend. Speak to the friend, then report to Cameron.

achievements.description: Upgrade every weapon to tier 3
achievements.summary: Upgrade all eight upgradeable weapons to Tier 3.

steps.text: Collect 72 schematics from mission rooms, safes, and side-job rewards.

After Bandel's Laboratory, use Tammy's Workshop or a Roadhouse upgrade station. Each weapon needs nine schematics. Upgrade the Micer, James Gun, Boomstick, Loose Cannon, Devarnisher, Kiss Kiss, Portable Freezer, and Jar-Head.
Pick up the Portable Freezer in Bandel's Mansion. Upgrade the remaining weapons at the station at the start of Fair Enough.

collectibles.method: Go down the stairs after the police fight, enter the shop on the right, and check outside its back door.

collectibles.name: Newspaper 10
collectibles.location: Chair inside the apartment reached by jump pad.
collectibles.method: After the fistfight, climb the apartment stairs and use the jump pad. Check to the left inside the window.

achievements.description: Collect 10 comic strips

collectibles.name: Comic 1
collectibles.location: Vent above the roulette room.
collectibles.method: Go upstairs after the roulette fight. Turn back toward the counter and crawl through the vent.

collectibles.name: Comic 2
collectibles.location: Stairs above the escape elevator.
collectibles.method: When the target takes the elevator, climb the stairs instead.

collectibles.name: Comic 3
collectibles.location: Auditorium seats by the MPD Rookie.
collectibles.method: Use the left backstage lever to open the curtain, then search the seats beside the rookie.

collectibles.name: Comic 4
collectibles.location: Bench beyond the subway entrance.
collectibles.method: Before entering the subway, check the street-end bench beside the Heal-D bottle.

collectibles.name: Comic 5
collectibles.location: Roof below the window after the Boomstick room.
collectibles.method: Drop through the window and look beneath the plank behind the barrel.

collectibles.name: Comic 6
collectibles.location: Cabinet in the room behind low flames.
collectibles.method: After photographing the burning audience, pass the typewriter. Jump over the flames at the side door and search the far cabinet.

collectibles.name: Comic 7
collectibles.location: Locked side room by a ladder and switch.
collectibles.method: After climbing the ladder, tailpick the door to the left of the switch. Search the chair.

collectibles.name: Comic 8
collectibles.location: Locked room beside the submerged train.
collectibles.method: After the second Robo-Betty fight, descend the ladder near the train. Tailpick the door by the switch and search the table.

collectibles.name: Comic 9
collectibles.location: Chair beyond the shop courtyard wall.
collectibles.method: Enter the shop after the two policemen at the gate. Shoot down the hanging platform and use its jump pad to cross the wall.

collectibles.name: Comic 10
collectibles.location: Desk in the large police office hall.
collectibles.method: Turn left on entering the hall, climb over the boxes, and search behind the desk papers.

achievements.description: Collect 5 issues of the Mouseburg Herald

collectibles.name: Newspaper 1
collectibles.location: The Vanishing Act: Locker just beyond the MPD Lieutenant.
collectibles.method: Show your ID and search the locker on the right through the opened door.

collectibles.name: Newspaper 2
collectibles.location: The Vanishing Act: Betty Deux-Fiddle's kitchen counter.
collectibles.method: Walk past Betty into the kitchen and take the issue from the counter.

collectibles.name: Newspaper 3
collectibles.location: Gumshoe in the Opera: Table just inside the entrance.
collectibles.method: Enter the opera building and check immediately to the right.

collectibles.name: Newspaper 4
collectibles.location: Gumshoe in the Opera: Chair beside the Old Rat Stuntman.
collectibles.method: Search beside the NPC who teaches double jump.

collectibles.name: Newspaper 5
collectibles.location: P.I. Office: Paperboy near Soup to Nuts after the opera.
collectibles.method: Pin the opera clues, then buy the new issue from the paperboy for 15 coins.

achievements.description: Win one Baseball Cards match

steps.text: Play at the Little & Big bar after The Vanishing Act. Choose player cards with higher strength than the opponent and add matching tactic cards to improve your hand.

achievements.description: Unlock X1 D-Mousifier - Spike-D’s "exclusive gun of sorts."

steps.text: Earn 20 Spike-D Tokens from Baseball Cards wins and side-job rewards.
Spend the tokens at the Prize D-Spenser beside John Brown in the Little & Big.

achievements.description: Collect 5 Baseball Cards

collectibles.name: Charlie Pepper
collectibles.location: The Vanishing Act: Table at the top of the first combat stairs.
collectibles.method: After the armor poster and first enemies, climb the stairs and check the low table on the right.

collectibles.name: Joel Blunt
collectibles.location: The Vanishing Act: Stool in the fire-escape apartment.
collectibles.method: Break the stairwell window, cross the fire escape, and enter the next apartment. Search beside the crate-blocked door.

collectibles.name: Austin "Cur" Bunz
collectibles.location: P.I. Office: Open bedroom drawer.
collectibles.method: Return after The Vanishing Act and search the bedroom dresser.

collectibles.name: Joe Jody Gain
collectibles.location: Gumshoe in the Opera: Card table near the light stand.
collectibles.method: After freeing Roland and collecting the Boomstick, check the far end of the room.

collectibles.name: Bartholomew Creasley
collectibles.location: Gumshoe in the Opera: Box behind the fence near the stuntman.
collectibles.method: After learning double jump, return to the cushion landing. Climb the wooden frame and jump across to the secret platform.

achievements.description: Collect all Baseball Cards. A real gathering, innit?

guide.context: Eight cards are sold only at Soup to Nuts and cost 6,000 coins in total. Two cards require side-job rewards. Mission cards you leave behind can appear in the shop for 100 coins, or you can recover them with Revisit.

collectibles.name: Charlie Pepper
collectibles.location: Table at the top of the first combat stairs.
collectibles.method: After the armor poster and first enemies, climb the stairs and check the low table on the right.

collectibles.name: Joel Blunt
collectibles.location: Stool in the fire-escape apartment.
collectibles.method: Break the stairwell window, cross the fire escape, and enter the next apartment. Search beside the crate-blocked door.

collectibles.name: Austin "Cur" Bunz
collectibles.location: Open bedroom drawer.
collectibles.method: Return after The Vanishing Act and search the bedroom dresser.

collectibles.name: Power Swing +2
collectibles.location: Soup to Nuts card shop.

collectibles.name: Jacob "Cheesehead" McQueen
collectibles.location: Cameron Bozo side-job reward.
collectibles.method: Accept Friends in Deep Places from Cameron before Glugging from the Deep. In the underwater cavern with the submarine, enter the side passage behind seaweed and climb the ladder to his friend. Speak to the friend, then report to Cameron.

collectibles.name: Joe Jody Gain
collectibles.location: Card table near the light stand.
collectibles.method: After freeing Roland and collecting the Boomstick, check the far end of the room.

collectibles.name: Bartholomew Creasley
collectibles.location: Box behind the fence near the stuntman.
collectibles.method: After learning double jump, return to the cushion landing. Climb the wooden frame and jump across to the secret platform.

collectibles.name: Mama Jody Gain
collectibles.location: Fenced space beneath the first Hot Pepper platform.
collectibles.method: Before climbing toward Robo-Betty, crouch through the gap under the main platform.

collectibles.name: Johnny Drawers
collectibles.location: Upper platform near the final laboratory switch.
collectibles.method: Climb through the robot firing platforms and double-jump across at the top.

collectibles.name: Jedediah Wetters
collectibles.location: Bottom of the stairs off the police-car street.
collectibles.method: After defeating the large officer, take the left route down the long staircase.

collectibles.name: Timmeh Rattycum
collectibles.location: Occupied prison cell.
collectibles.method: In the cell block, inspect the cell opposite the explosive-barrel entrance and take the visible card.

collectibles.name: Daniel "The Rat-ta-Train" Cruz
collectibles.location: Clothesline in a locked room above the tracks.
collectibles.method: After the dug-up floor and next typewriter, go upstairs. Turn left at the tracks and tailpick the door.

collectibles.name: Justin Young
collectibles.location: Secret room beside the typewriter after Gabe Clarkle.
collectibles.method: Use D-namite on the cracked wall to the right and break the boxes inside.

collectibles.name: Joshua Diaz
collectibles.location: Upper platform behind the backstage cargo.
collectibles.method: Outside the room with Wanda's Letter, cross the gap with double jump and Tail-a-Chopper. Search behind the large crates.

collectibles.name: Johnny "Blaze" Sweets
collectibles.location: Submerged crates beside the hanging shark.
collectibles.method: Face the shark, drop into the water on the right, and search the crates beneath the floating bottles.

collectibles.name: Marian Bunz-Twarog
collectibles.location: Windowsill in the locked courtyard shop.
collectibles.method: After buying Cameron Bozo's key, drop into the courtyard. Break the three boxes and tailpick the door; check the sill on the right.

collectibles.group: A Bit of Curd and Pepper
collectibles.name: Jake "Saucepan" Black
collectibles.location: Bucket at the far end of the upper balcony.
collectibles.method: Swing across the hooks beside the locked entrance and enter the opening in the wall. Follow the upper balcony from that room to its boarded end. Double-jump over the boards and search the cleaner's bucket.

collectibles.name: Johnny "C-Train" Goudenberg
collectibles.location: Pressure cooker outside the Old Cheeselegger's shack.
collectibles.method: Face away from the Old Cheeselegger after your conversation. Take the card from the pressure cooker next to the barrel.

collectibles.name: Donny Makesz
collectibles.location: Inside the water tower.
collectibles.method: In the first hideout building on the right, go upstairs and take the warp pipe to the card.

collectibles.name: Rube Sharp
collectibles.location: Crate behind the village barn.
collectibles.method: After leaving the mine, take the route away from the manor and follow the barn's outer walkway.

collectibles.name: Josef Bunz-Konitcky
collectibles.location: Upper mausoleum passage.
collectibles.method: After defeating the Third Wife and opening the gates, climb to the highest passage. Search the corner of a gravestone.

collectibles.name: Jenny Jody Gain
collectibles.location: Window opposite T.N.T. WATCH IT EXPLODE.
collectibles.method: Cross the gap from the carnival game to the window and search the crate inside.

collectibles.name: Brandon "Binger" Ortiz
collectibles.location: Skeleton inside the reward-shop vent.
collectibles.method: After spending the two reward tickets, tailpick the door opposite the typewriter. Destroy the barrels and follow the hidden vent.

collectibles.name: William Brown
collectibles.location: Closet opposite the skeleton with the comic.
collectibles.method: After demolishing the wall and entering the side room, open the closet and take the card from the skeleton.

collectibles.name: Mickey Brown
collectibles.location: Room behind the chain-link fence.
collectibles.method: After repairing the elevator, return to the shop area. Reach the newly open warp pipe, cross to the next pipe, and use it.

collectibles.name: Claude Ewer
collectibles.location: Second train carriage.
collectibles.method: After following the Bookkeeper's crane beam, enter the train and check behind the ladder and crates.

collectibles.name: William Lee-Gains
collectibles.location: Behind the rocks by the HERE LIES JANE grave.
collectibles.method: After leaving the moving train-film sequence, check the grave beside the next typewriter.

collectibles.name: Papa Jody Gain
collectibles.location: Secret room behind the wardrobe.
collectibles.method: Play A-C-E-G on the Music Room piano. Return to the Old Shrew's room and enter the opened wardrobe; search the wall by the skeleton.

collectibles.name: Harold "Fisto" Blunt
collectibles.location: Crate behind the trees on the color set.
collectibles.method: On entering the color forest, search the far corner for a gap between the trees. Take the card from the crate inside.

collectibles.name: Zachary Lee
collectibles.location: Refrigerator in the far corner of the castle combat room.
collectibles.method: Take the card from the refrigerator before finishing the fight. If the room has flooded, swim back to the same refrigerator and watch your air.

collectibles.name: Brian Coker
collectibles.location: Open medical cabinet beside the shortcut doors.
collectibles.method: At the final Millie objective, take the warp-pipe route past the sniper. Use the next pipe and follow the corridor to the cabinet beside the baseball bat.

collectibles.name: Noah "The Rat Baron" Kelly
collectibles.location: Skeleton in the starting building's vent.
collectibles.method: Clear the entrance fight, then find the side room containing a jump pad. Use the stair-bottom vent to reach the skeleton.

collectibles.name: Thomas Thomas
collectibles.location: Raised shipping container opposite the Hungry Pelican.
collectibles.method: At the main dock, jump to the container beside the crane hook and search the cargo inside.

achievements.description: Kill 10 enemies within 20 seconds. M-m-muenster Kill!

steps.text: In the large Cheeseball Sub train-yard fight, gather enemies near the explosive barrels. Kill the group quickly with the Boomstick and barrel explosions.

achievements.description: Wrap up the Missing Magician case

guide.context: If evidence is missing, revisit the relevant mission and pin the recovered clues at the office. Keep a separate manual save before the final case clue; case achievements can occasionally fail to unlock.

steps.text: Use the optional-clue checklist under Burdens of Blue Betty and complete the available side jobs. Defeat Ze Professor in Glugging from the Deep and collect Ze Professor & BMP.

achievements.description: Kill 20 enemies in a single playthrough by throwing/kicking explosive barrels
achievements.summary: Kill 20 enemies in one playthrough by throwing or kicking explosive barrels.

guide.context: Kills remain counted when you reload a save, so one suitable encounter is enough.

steps.text: In Gumshoe in the Opera, use the room with an explosive barrel and suspended crate before the stage cannon. Make a manual save before the enemy appears.
Throw or kick the barrel into the enemy, then reload the save and repeat until 20 kills are counted.

achievements.description: Blast 20 enemies in a single playthrough by shooting at explosive barrels.
achievements.summary: Kill 20 enemies in one playthrough by shooting explosive barrels.

guide.context: Thrown or kicked barrels count toward Boom Town instead. Barrel kills remain counted after reloading.

steps.text: In Gumshoe in the Opera, save before the enemy appears in the room with a barrel and suspended crate before the stage cannon.
Shoot the barrel while the enemy is beside it. Reload and repeat until you have 20 barrel kills.

achievements.description: Wrap up the Shrew Shortage case

guide.context: If earlier evidence is missing, use Revisit to recover it and pin the clues at the office. Keep a separate manual save before the final case clue; case achievements can occasionally fail to unlock.

steps.text: Use Burdens of Blue Betty to check earlier optional-clue locations and complete the available side jobs. In To Catch a Mockingmouse, photograph Captain Simms to obtain Simms & BMP.

achievements.description: Crush 20 enemies with heavy objects in a single playthrough.
achievements.summary: During a single playthrough, kill 20 enemies by dropping heavy objects onto them.

guide.context: Crushing kills remain counted after a save reload.

steps.text: In Gumshoe in the Opera, save before the enemy appears beneath the suspended crate in the room before the stage cannon.
Shoot the suspension to drop the crate onto the enemy. Reload and repeat until 20 crushing kills are counted.

achievements.description: Wrap up the Blue Betty case

guide.context: If earlier evidence is missing, use Revisit to recover it and pin the clues at the office. Keep a separate manual save before the final case clue; case achievements can occasionally fail to unlock.

steps.text: Use Burdens of Blue Betty to check earlier optional-clue locations and finish the available side jobs. In Fatal Repulsions, collect Letter from Vivian at the end of the investigation.

achievements.description: Kick the Wallop Bay shark till it drops the license plate
achievements.summary: Kick the hanging shark in Wallop Bay until it drops a license plate.

guide.context: If you pass the shark, revisit Saltwater Cambozo from the overworld map.

steps.text: At the start of Saltwater Cambozo, look for the whale-topped diner. Kick the shark hanging outside until a license plate falls out.

achievements.description: Kill 3 enemies with one shot.

steps.text: Bring three enemies beside an explosive barrel and shoot the barrel once to kill the group.

achievements.description: Rest easy, detective. Case closed… or is it?

steps.text: Defeat the final enemies aboard Der Harzerburg, rescue John, and finish the conversation to reach the ending.

achievements.description: Clock a BMP agitator right in the snout.
achievements.summary: Punch the BMP Agitator outside the Little & Big.

guide.context: If you advance past this hub visit, load that manual save to return to the encounter.

steps.text: When The Bookkeeper becomes available, make a manual save before leaving the hub. Find the BMP Agitator near Wanda outside the Little & Big and use the punch interaction.
